visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two-column technical data table: one row per motorization with bold name, WLTP consumption text and a PDF data-sheet Download link, or a label/value spec table
visualCharacteristics.layout: semantic <table>, two columns at every width; value column sized to its content; scrolls horizontally if it overflows
visualCharacteristics.extras: keeps <strong>, <sub> (CO2) and <sup> markup in cells; first cell of every body row is the row header

contentPattern.structure: one row per table row, two cells: label (richtext) and value (richtext). Layout A (summary): header option on, first row '' | 'Data sheet', then per motorization: name + consumption paragraph | 'Download' link to the PDF. Layout B (single motorization): no header option, rows spec label | value. The header row is set only by the 'header' option, never inferred from the content.

reuseGuidance: Use for real tabular data with two columns (data sheets, spec label/value lists); use the header option when the first row holds column titles.
